pinev: 1911 Henry Co atlas, Wethersfield Twp plate p. 6 (Ancestry image 31617_072109-00008): 'James Johnston 160' in the E half / S part of sec 21 T14N R5E (about the SE quarter), ~4.1 mi S of Kewanee, matching the 1897 'four miles directly south of town' (BLM sec 21 = 41.1783-41.1929, -89.9452..-89.9258).
No D. C. Harraden on the 1911 plate; 1875 not checked.
